about.description: Hundreds of models & providers. One command to find what runs on your hardware.

name: v1.1.21
body:
## [1.1.21](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/compare/v1.1.20...v1.1.21) (2026-11-23)


### Features

* **bench:** --tool-calls probes whether a model returns tool calls ([#1173](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/issues/1173)) ([df07f51](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/commit/df07f5146bfc06dad5472993fcc12dfe04a67f38))
* **i18n:** add German translations for web, desktop, and README ([#1144](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/issues/1144)) ([d03b89a](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/commit/d03b89ad34148b0f8a7792784209684ff9afb75a))


### Bug Fixes

* **cli:** report gpu_available_gb, free_vram_gb and memory_bandwidth_gbps in system --json ([#1258](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/issues/1258)) ([463c4b9](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/commit/463c4b96e7ae956a97f4ff3d3b9e55e331842f9e))
* **hardware:** filter Microsoft Basic Render Driver from Vulkan GPUs ([#1250](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/issues/1250)) ([72e93bb](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/commit/72e93bbf4129cf9f8240536703a7381a761b949f))
* **hardware:** preserve AMD sysfs PCIe lane widths ([#1213](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/issues/1213)) ([d5260c0](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/commit/d5260c0413074bf1bd71cfbd24315a7a402f9f4f))
* match benchmark GPU counts ([#1237](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/issues/1237)) ([20e94cf](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/commit/20e94cf454bde4e8d2637eb1d34bf677915138d0))
* **providers:** rank IQ4_XS and IQ3_M by bit width in select_best_gguf ([#1263](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/issues/1263)) ([4d412ab](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/commit/4d412abaaa0cd58b6e920261cdc30fc79ea061aa))
* **scraper:** keep inferred context lengths within u32 ([#1247](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/issues/1247)) ([5067396](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/commit/5067396ee2d4ab10df079aaa3fb642173f685d26))
* **serve:** match every word of a multi-word search in the API and MCP server ([#1264](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/issues/1264)) ([22c2422](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/commit/22c2422792bf46abd198e97e1d636aa7d0abf8dc))
* **share:** time out GitHub requests instead of hanging forever ([#1265](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/issues/1265)) ([87a2f6b](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/commit/87a2f6b891d2f7cc2ba15ff1e465701c422c0cc2))
* show Vulkan memory heaps in doctor report ([#1238](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/issues/1238)) ([bd64622](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/commit/bd64622a8a05a956eb5808560d6557ba2905f458))
* **update:** let config.json expert counts win over the 17B-16E name rule ([#1249](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/issues/1249)) ([6f44b29](https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/commit/6f44b293f59b718efb27754af57d95c5cd3abd78))

## What's Changed
* fix(hardware): preserve AMD sysfs PCIe lane widths by @Ehsan-hash in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1213
* fix: match benchmark GPU counts by @luojiyin1987 in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1237
* bench: community results for radeon-rx-7900-xt-7900-xtx by @kortasma in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1239
* fix: show Vulkan memory heaps in doctor report by @luojiyin1987 in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1238
* test(plan): compare disk_size_gb with a tolerance, not bit-for-bit by @michaeljabbour in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1242
* chore(deps): bump the cargo-minor-patch group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1243

* feat(bench): --tool-calls probes whether a model returns tool calls by @grosjeanbaptiste in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1173
* refactor(bench): resolve the speed bench's target through resolve_bench_target by @grosjeanbaptiste in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1252
* fix(scraper): reject context lengths outside the u32 range by @shenxi200-eng in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1247

* fix(share): time out GitHub requests instead of hanging forever by @divya0795 in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1265
* chore(deps): bump async-nats from 0.50.0 to 0.51.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1262
* chore(deps): bump the cargo-minor-patch group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1259
* fix(cli): report gpu_available_gb, free_vram_gb and memory_bandwidth_gbps in system --json by @Assertive-xxh in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1258
* fix(providers): rank IQ4_XS and IQ3_M by bit width in select_best_gguf by @divya0795 in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1263
* fix(serve): match every word of a multi-word search in the API and MCP server by @ruanchaves in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1264
* bench: community results for radeon-rx-6800-xt by @TheSaneWriter in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1218
* [Automated] Weekly benchmark cache refresh by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1219
* chore(deps): bump the cargo-minor-patch group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1271
* feat(i18n): add German translations for web, desktop, and README by @Huskynarr in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1144
* bench: community results for nvidia-geforce-gtx-1060-6gb by @dimtank in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1214
* [Automated] Weekly model data refresh by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1220
* chore(deps): bump toml from 0.8.2 to 1.1.8+spec-1.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1245
* [Automated] Weekly benchmark cache refresh by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1275
* chore(main): release 1.1.21 by @AlexsJones in https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit/pull/1234
